Name: Shardust's Fences Gate Flooring
Author: Shardust
TagLine: This a series of retextures of the game's Flooring, Fences, and gate.
Description:
SHARDUST'S FENCES GATE FLOORING

(Requires SMAPI 3.1.0 and Content Patcher(and Gate Fix to see all gate options instead of only one) and was tested with the currently STABLE (at the time of the upload) version of the game. )

This a series of retextures of the game's Fences, Gate and Flooring, with several  colors available for each. 
Each item has been either recolored or retextured and has several different options available. 
Their respective in-game icons will change along with them.
You can change one of the Fences into an Hedge Fence, which has several colors available, and can be "upgraded" to a seasonal variant that will change the grass color by the seasons and will also automatically detect if you have a Map Recolor active among the list below.
An additional option to have a "snow-ish" look in winter for Fences, Hedges, and Gate is available.
Flooring also has seasonal variants available like the Hedges, and a Winter version working with the one added in the 1.4 patch.

Current Map Recolors compatibility/dependancy (as in, the Hedges and Straw Seasonal Options wll only be available if you have installed one of those, otherwise they will use the Vanilla colors):

"Rose Colored Glasses -- A Map Recolor" by vamoosi
"Eemie's Just A New Map Recolour - Content Patcher Edition" by minervamaga
"untitledmaprecolour01" by andrewist
"A Wittily Named Recolor" by acerbicon
"Starblue Valley Maps Updated - Beach and Desert Maps and Content Patcher and More" by strangelyliteral

Start the game once and it will generate a config.json file inside the mod folder. You can change options from those available there.
To disable an option just write "false" in the config where it is available.

My deepest thanks to SpringSong and all the peeps in the official Stardew Valley Discord for all the help with the coding et all!
